_meta.title: PostgreSQL database
_meta.setup: Ideally a dedicated read-only user: CREATE ROLE claude_ro LOGIN PASSWORD '…'; GRANT pg_read_all_data TO claude_ro; (PostgreSQL 14+). Put user and password into .env.

examples: svc db NAME "SELECT count(*) FROM users"
notes: ro: the session is read-only – a read-only database user is the real protection.
